hero.title: HappyHorse 1.0 Text to Video

HappyHorse 1.0 helps you turn a simple prompt into a polished 3-15s cinematic clip. It keeps the workflow focused with native 16:9 framing, 720p output, and optional seed control for repeatable drafts.

Need to animate a still frame instead? Try HappyHorse 1.0 Image to Video.

q1.question: What is HappyHorse 1.0 Text to Video?
q1.answer: It is an AI video workflow that turns a text prompt into a 3-15s 720p video clip using Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0.

q2.question: What aspect ratio does it support?
q2.answer: The current text-to-video workflow is optimized for 16:9 output.

q3.question: Can I choose the duration?
q3.answer: This release supports selectable 3-15s generation for quick iteration and longer previewing.

q4.question: What is the seed used for?
q4.answer: A seed helps you reproduce or stabilize results when you want similar generations across multiple runs.

q5.question: Who is this model good for?
q5.answer: It works well for creators, marketers, and product teams who need short cinematic concept clips from text.

q5.question: When should I use Image to Video instead of Text to Video?
